scope: Three Swift WMO app builds; sequential baseline-A-B-B-A-baseline, same PTY driver and geometry. Not display FPS.

report.note: Same PTY payloads and ordered DSR drain; alternate screen excludes scrollback. CPU and footprint are terminal parent process only. Footprint is sampled at run ends, not peak. This measures parsing/backpressure, not display FPS or input-to-photon latency.
